notes.title: Boss and Spell Casting Update! (v. 1.7.0)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added 5 mini bosses to Training and Protect the Fish God - [b]Mega Dashard, Iceard, Pushard, Grabard and Squishard! [/b]
[*] Added a "element queue" system when spell casting. The old system can still be accessed by selecting "auto clear spells" in the settings tab.
[*] Lowered the amount of kills necessary for some achievements.  
[*] Fixed many bugs including the "stuck-5-meters-above-ground-bug" and the bug where certain element amount achievements weren't stored.
[*] Arcane walls work again.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.6.1
notes.content:
- Fixed dummy issue in tutorial.
- Added dummies with 100hp.
- Fixed bug were several arcane walls are created.
- Fixes and improvements to Fish Ball - it's not possible to push players outside the map anymore.
- Increased max players to 12.

notes.title: Fish Ball, Class Balancing and Bug-Fixing Patch!
notes.content:
This patch focuses on balancing the classes by making weak spells stronger and more interesting.

We also added a new mini game called "Fish Ball" where players try to shoot a ball into the other team's goal by using magic!

Several bugs where fixed too.

notes.title: Post release patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Nerf to Camping Carl class with longer cooldowns to dive and rock dash. Minor changes to heal too.
[*] Optimised Protect Gooey God by spawning less but stronger enemies.
[*] Bug fixes to the cosmetic/ achievement rank system. 
[/list]

notes.title: Tutorial and Training Demo Update!
notes.content:
[h2]What has been done?[/h2]
- Added a tutorial.
- Added a training map where you can improve your fish wizard skills by fighting against endless waves of evil fishards! 
- Better lobby functionality: ping display, kick functionality and more...
- Much bug fixing and balancing

If you haven't tried the demo you should! Also, don't forget to WISHLIST the full game! :)
